transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I’ve been having thoughts like... maybe it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up. I haven’t made any plan to hurt myself, but it’s been bothering me enough that I thought I should talk to someone.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It’s been about three months now, I think. Ever since that crash, I just haven’t really come back up from it.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or have lost interest in activities you once liked?

Yeah. I used to like things like fishing, going through my vinyl records, tailgating, even checking on my home-brew. Those were kind of my ways to unwind. Lately I just don’t care about any of it. If I try to do them, they feel more like chores than anything I actually enjoy.
Have you been feeling like you’re a failure or that you’ve let people down, even if you know it might not be entirely your fault?

Yeah... I have. After that burst of energy wore off, it was like somebody pulled the plug on me. I’d just sit at the kitchen table staring at my coffee, feeling empty and ashamed, like I’d let everybody down somehow.
Have you noticed that your movements have slowed down, or that you can't sit still the way you used to?

I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed myself moving slower, and I don’t think I’ve been pacing or anything like that. Mostly I just feel kind of worn down, but I can’t say I’ve seen a big change in how I move.
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth much or that you’re a burden to others?

Yeah... I guess so. After that burst of energy wore off, it felt like somebody just pulled the plug on me. I’d sit there at the table staring into my coffee, feeling empty and ashamed, like I wasn’t worth much.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight recently?
Yeah, I think so. Most days I kind of have to remind myself to eat. Supper will be sitting there and it just feels like too much trouble, and my jeans have been fitting looser lately.
Have you noticed that it's been harder to focus on things, like reading or following a conversation, or that your thoughts feel slowed down?

I don’t know, not really. I haven’t noticed my thoughts being especially slow. I mean, I get tired and I might lose my place now and then, but I can still follow what people are saying most of the time.
Have you ever felt this way before, like you were stuck in a low mood or lost interest in things for a long time?
Yeah… after that high-energy spell wore off, I got pretty low. It was like someone just pulled the plug on me. I’d sit at the kitchen table staring into my coffee, feeling empty and ashamed.
Before this most recent episode, have you ever had a period lasting several weeks or longer where you felt down, lost interest in things, or experienced similar symptoms?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I’ve had rough patches before, but I can’t say for sure it was several weeks or the same kind of thing. It’s hard to separate normal stress from something more than that.
Before this most recent episode, have you ever had a period lasting several weeks or longer where you felt down, lost interest in things, or experienced similar symptoms?
I don’t really know. I can think of times I was stressed or down for a bit, but I can’t say it lasted several weeks or was the same as this. It’s kind of hard for me to pin down.
Before this most recent episode, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks in a way that felt similar to what you’ve been experiencing lately?
I’m not sure. I’ve had times where I felt down or didn’t feel like doing much, but I can’t really say it went on more than two weeks like this has. I don’t remember it clearly enough to say yes.
Before this most recent time, have you ever had a period where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks in a way that felt similar to what you’ve been experiencing lately?
I honestly can’t say for sure. I’ve had times where I felt kind of down or not as interested in things, but I don’t remember a clear stretch of more than two weeks before this that felt the same.
Before this most recent time, have you ever had a period where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks that was similar to this episode?
Not that I can clearly remember. I’ve had rough patches before, but I can’t point to one that lasted more than two weeks and felt like this.
Before this most recent time, have you ever had a period where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks that was similar to this episode, even if you didn't seek help for it?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had down times here and there, but I can’t remember a clear period before this where it lasted over two weeks like that, even if I didn’t get help for it.
Before this most recent time, have you ever had a period where you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row?
I’m not really sure. I don’t remember a time before this where it was clearly two weeks straight like that.

Before this most recent time, have you ever had a period where you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row, even if it didn’t seem serious enough to bring up with someone?
I really can’t say that I have. I’ve had times where I felt low, but before this recent one, I don’t remember it lasting two weeks straight.
